Each file is read fully and output can grow, bounded externally by container memory/time and captured-output limits. Source is unchanged and only the current private fixture is mounted
The generated tool runs only in a pinned offline container with fresh per-invocation state
Expected answers stay in the external case validator; no candidate fixture contains answers
